units.source_text: 在这段心神不宁的日子里，我仍有独自静坐的空闲，偶尔还能看上十几页书。

en.t: Even during those restless days, I still had leisure to sit quietly by myself, and now and then I could even read a dozen pages or so.

units.source_text: 已经打好的行李不知什么时候全解开了，我从里面取出各种要用的物件。

en.t: The luggage I had already packed had somehow been unpacked, and I took from it various things I needed.

units.source_text: 我检查了一下离开东京之前，计划好的在这个暑假里复习的功课，实行的还不到计划的三分之一。

en.t: When I looked over the studies I had planned before leaving Tokyo to review that summer, I found I had carried out less than a third of the plan.

units.source_text: 虽说这种不愉快从前也有过多次，可还从来没有过过得这样不顺心的暑假。

en.t: Although I had experienced this kind of displeasure many times before, I had never spent a summer that went so contrary to my wishes.

units.source_text: 虽然我知道这是人世之常，却仍感到忧烦。

en.t: Though I knew this was the way of the world, I still felt troubled and depressed.

units.source_text: 我心情郁闷地坐着，想着父亲的病情，想象着他死后的情景，同时，还想起了先生。

en.t: I sat there in gloom, thinking about my father's illness, imagining what things would be like after his death, and at the same time remembering Sensei.

units.source_text: 我凝望着这两个构成郁闷心情两端的，地位、修养、性格都迥然不同的面影。

en.t: I gazed at the images of these two men, who formed opposite ends of my gloomy thoughts and differed utterly in position, cultivation, and character.

units.source_text: 当我离开父亲的枕边，抱着胳膊独自坐在杂乱的书堆中想心事的时候，母亲来了。

en.t: When I had left my father's bedside and was sitting alone among the disorderly piles of books with my arms folded, lost in thought, my mother came in.

units.source_text: “睡一会儿午觉吧，你也够累的了。”

en.t: "Why not take a little nap? You must be quite tired too."

units.source_text: 母亲并不懂得我的心情，我也不再是对母亲抱有这样期待的孩子了。

en.t: My mother did not understand how I felt, and I was no longer a child who expected that of her.

units.source_text: 我只是回应了一句“不累”。
母亲还是站在门口，没有进来。

en.t: My mother still stood at the doorway and did not come in.
"He is sleeping now," my mother answered.

units.source_text: 母亲突然走进来，坐在我身旁，问道：“先生还是没有回信吗？”

en.t: My mother suddenly came in, sat down beside me, and asked, "Has Sensei still not written back?"
